rationale: S005 bundles two independently checkable obligations: (a) steps are ordered and numbered; (b) each step declares its pre-conditions and outputs. They have different evidence, so they become two parts. The source makes both mandatory together, with no exemption for any change type. So both parts get the SAME activation (any change to a wagon procedure step list, including removal, reorder and numbering-only edits) and require each other. This fixes the prior audit finding that the declarations part was too narrow.

parts.given: A document contains a wagon procedure written as steps

avoid: Unnumbered or unordered steps whose execution order a reader must guess.
parts.why: Ordered, numbered steps with pre-conditions and outputs make a wagon procedure reproducible and checkable.

Reviewer confirms each step carries a number.

parts.given: A document contains a wagon procedure written as steps
parts.when: the step list is written, or any step is added, removed, moved, renumbered or edited
parts.then: Every step declares its pre-conditions (what it requires before running) and its outputs (what it produces after).
avoid: Steps whose pre-conditions or outputs are missing or unclear.
parts.why: Ordered, numbered steps with pre-conditions and outputs make a wagon procedure reproducible and checkable.
evidence: Reviewer confirms every step declares its pre-conditions.
Reviewer confirms every step declares its outputs.

Severity 2, disposition documentation-only: checked by review. The source defines no automated detector.
The source requires no particular declaration format. It does not require that a step's pre-conditions come from an earlier step's outputs.
